Class Menu

java.lang.Object
entity.Menu
public class Menu extends Object
The restaurant's menu: the fixed list of dishes a customer can order as well as a custom menu that the caller can create.

    • withCombos

      public static Menu withCombos()
      Creates the Stage 3 menu: the standard dishes followed by one combo meal (Salad + Pasta).

      Customers choose by position in the list, so the combo is chosen the same way as any other dish. It sits at the END so that the standard dishes keep their positions. standard() is unchanged, so the Stage 1 and Stage 2 runs stay the same.

      creates new MenuItems for combo instead of reading out from Menu.standard() in case standard menu items are reordered.

      Returns:
      a menu with Salad, Burger, Pasta and the Salad + Pasta combo
